main_text.p: dam ludi, Suetonio Hastici vocati: per errorem à quibusdam dicti Actiaci. Hodie vocabulo Virgil.l. 8.Æneid.minus latino Torneamenta appellata, & inverso modo Trojamenta: forte quia à Trojanâ juventute, quam in hoc ludi genere institutam fuisse, testis est Virgilius, ad nostra usque tempora succession quâ pervenerunt. Hoc tamen servato discrimine, quod hodiernis moribus, non pueri, quod ex veterum instituto obtinebat, sed viri inter se concurrant. Neque amplius nudato capite, aut coronato, verum pressâ galeâ ineatur certamen.

Ut hic ludus sit lanceaŕia[?] quædam decursio cataphractorum, in quâ singuli concurrunt, intermediâ de more lineâ erectarum tabularum discreti. Quod ludi genus hodie, maxime periculosum, nullamque adferens utilitatem, illicitum

page.notes: The printed word "maxime" should read "maxime"; the 'e' after "maxi" is printed in a slightly different size, so this is a transcription uncertainty, and I have transcribed it as printed. "lanceaŕia" is uncertain: the letter after "lanceaŕ" could be "r" or a worn letter, so it is marked [?]. The word "esse" at the lower right is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. A horizontal rule at the bottom of the page and a faint "Google" watermark are not printed text and are omitted.
